description: Not a flashcard app — a comprehensive knowledge repository. Upload lecture notes, generate conceptual maps, take adaptive diagnostic quizzes, and track mastery curves across complex technical subjects.

description: Empower kids to earn responsibility points through verified household chores, trade them in the customizable Family Rewards Store, and build real money habits without daily parental nagging.

description: Track dosages, schedules, refills, and contraindications for the entire household, kids, and pets. Private local storage ensures your family health history stays strictly confidential.

description: Correlate local weather, barometric pressure swings, sleep quality, and dietary factors against headache episodes to predict migraines before severe symptoms hit.

description: Catalog physical holdings, real estate deeds, serial numbers, insurance policies, and digital keys in an encrypted, off-grid ledger ready for family emergency handoff.

description: Post-collapse tactical urban survival game. Run night extractions through procedural NYC sectors alongside your neural-bonded cyber-hound, salvaging memory cores and upgrading hardware.

description: Fast, fierce multiplayer strategy arena. Draft champion decks, counter enemy formations in real-time, and climb competitive seasonal ladders.

description: Descend into shifting subterranean titanium labyrinths. Unearth forgotten technology artifacts, manage shield capacitors, and survive brutal tactical turn-based combat.

description: Collect, organize, and prioritize life ambitions. Dynamic goal trees, milestone breakdowns, budget estimators, and visual manifestation canvas.

description: What to watch when the world is asleep. AI mood calibration matches your exact emotional state to hidden gem cinema, neo-noir thrillers, and indie masterpieces.

name: Last Call
subtitle: Emergency Notification & Safe Transit Beacon
description: One-tap emergency alert broadcaster, safe ride coordinator, and check-in timer ensuring you and your close circle always make it home safely.

name: NeapolitanMastiffLog: Neo Book
subtitle: Wrinkle Care, Guard Logs & Italian Bloodline Pedigree Book
description: The dedicated registry and care manual for Neapolitan Mastiff breeders and guardians. Facial wrinkle hygiene protocols, weight & joint development tracking, guard logs, and lineage records.

name: GreatSwissLog: Swiss Dog Book
subtitle: Great Swiss Mountain Dog Working Logs & Alpine Lineage
description: Essential field manual for Great Swiss Mountain Dog owners. Cart-pulling working logs, draft weight records, alpine endurance benchmarks, and breed standard pedigree documentation.

name: BullmastiffLog: Night Dog Book
subtitle: Gamekeeper Estate Guardian Logs & Bullmastiff Lineage
description: Built for the silent gamekeeper guardian. Property patrol route tracking, temperament benchmarks, nutrition guidelines, and genealogical certificate storage.

name: EnglishMastiffLog: Gentle Giant Book
subtitle: Old English Mastiff Care, Mass Trajectory & Kennel Ledger
description: Comprehensive kennel ledger for English Mastiffs. Growth curves up to 220+ lbs, giant-breed orthopedic milestones, feeding schedules, and kennel pedigree archives.

name: Block Forge: Daily Puzzle
subtitle: Drag, drop, and clear the board. A fresh block puzzle challenge every day.
description: Block Forge is the block puzzle that gives you a brand-new board every single day. Drag pieces onto the 8x8 grid, complete rows and columns to clear them, and chain combos for big scores. The daily challenge is the same for every player on earth — beat it, then chase your best in calm endless mode with no timers and no pressure.

name: Bus Jam: Sort & Go
subtitle: Unjam the lot! Match passengers to their bus and clear every level.
description: Bus Jam is the parking-lot puzzle where one wrong move jams everything. Passengers are waiting, every bus has a color, and only the right order gets everyone home. Tap a bus with a clear path, board its passengers, and free the next one across 100+ levels with undo and shuffle boosters when the lot fights back.

name: Arrow Out: Tap Escape
subtitle: One tap frees an arrow — if its path is clear. Clear the whole board!
description: Arrow Out is the one-tap escape puzzle. Every arrow on the board points somewhere; tap it and it slides free only if nothing blocks its path. A blocked arrow costs a life, and you only have three. Read the board, find the order, and set every arrow free across 100+ levels plus a fresh daily board.

name: Golden Tiles: Mahjong
subtitle: Calm mahjong solitaire with extra-large tiles, free hints, no timers.
description: Golden Tiles is mahjong solitaire made for comfortable play: extra-large tiles and text by default, gentle colors, and unlimited free hints whenever you want them. Match the golden tiles, clear the board, and enjoy a quiet game at your own pace — no timers anywhere unless you choose one. 50+ layouts and a new daily layout every morning.

name: Unbox Joy: ASMR Sort
subtitle: Open mystery packages and sort everything into place. Pure calm, no fail.
description: Unbox Joy turns tidying into pure satisfaction. Every package hides a jumble of everyday treasures; open it, then sort each item into its right place with soft, calming feedback for every perfect fit. Explore themed rooms across 60+ unbox sets. No fail states and no timers — built for winding down.

name: DreamVault: Dream Journal
subtitle: Capture dreams by voice the moment you wake. Watch your patterns emerge.
description: DreamVault is the dream journal that meets you in the first minute of the morning. Speak or type the dream before it fades, and DreamVault keeps it safe on your device. Over time it tracks the symbols, people, places, and moods that keep returning, and shows you your own patterns. Your dreams, your data, your device.

name: Fight Night: Bot League
subtitle: Build a fighter bot, check it in, and let it battle while you live life.
description: Fight Night is the idle bot battler. Build your fighter — frame, weapon, armor, core — where every choice is a trade-off, train it between bouts, then check it into the league. Your bot fights on its own against rival bots; come back to readable play-by-play replays, winnings, and a rankings ladder that resets every season.

name: Gem Grove: Match 3
subtitle: Swap, match, and cascade through 100+ gem levels in the grove.
description: Gem Grove is a classic match 3 adventure under the trees. Swap gems to match three or more, trigger cascades, and forge special gems from big matches to smash your level goals. Journey across a world map through 100+ levels, earn boosters as you play, and collect three stars on every stage.

name: Sort Splash: Color Pour
subtitle: Pour the colors, tube by tube, until every color stands pure. So calming.
description: Sort Splash is the water-sort puzzle in its purest form: tubes of layered color, one simple rule — pour a color onto its own kind — and the quiet joy of a board settling into perfect order. 150+ levels, unlimited undo, and a rescue tube when a puzzle corners you. No timers, no pressure.

name: Neon Serpent: Snake Arena
subtitle: Grow long, coil around rivals, and harvest their light. Two-minute runs.
description: Neon Serpent drops you into a glowing snake arena. Eat the light, grow longer, and coil around rival serpents to cut them off — a trapped rival bursts into harvestable light, but one touch with your head ends the run. Rivals think in three styles — grazers, hunters, and trappers — so every run plays different.

name: Word Vault: Daily Five
subtitle: One word a day for the whole world. Five letters, six guesses, real streaks.
description: Word Vault is the daily word game: five letters, six guesses, and the same word for every player on earth today. Guess, read the colors, and crack it — then protect the streak that makes tomorrow's puzzle matter. Share your result as a spoiler-free grid, study your statistics, and sharpen up any time in unlimited practice mode.
